text:
Predicates:
Likes(x, y) ::: x likes y.
Wants(x, y) ::: x wants to y.
Access(x, y) ::: x has access to y.
Compose(x, y) ::: x can compose y.
WillCompose(x, y) ::: x will compose y.
Premises:
(Likes(George, music) → Wants(George, compose)) ::: If George likes music, he wants to compose.
(Access(George, program) → Compose(George, program)) ::: If George has access to a program, he can compose.
(Compose(George, program) ∧ Wants(George, compose)) → WillCompose(George, program) ::: If George can compose and wants to compose, he will compose.
Conclusion:
¬WillCompose(George, program) ↔ ¬Compose(George, program)
